transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um... well, work's just been a problem lately. I guess I'm having trouble keeping my focus on one estimate or, you know, a code form. It's like... if I hear a tool noise, or get a text, or just have some new idea about the workshop, I get completely pulled off track. And... well, jobs are starting to get mixed up because of it. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Did you have trouble staying focused like this when you were a child?
Um... no. Not that I remember. School was fine, mostly. It wasn't really an issue back then.
Have you been feeling down or depressed مؤخراً?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I don't think so. Just... mostly the focus thing.
Did this trouble with focus start after a particularly stressful event or period in your life?

I mean... I don't know if I'd call it a stressful event, really. But... I guess it's been building up for a while. Maybe about seven months or so? That's... uh, that's when we took on the mortgage for the workshop. And the new equipment. So... yeah, I guess it started around then.
Have you been worrying a lot lately?
Uh... no, not really. I mean, I think about the shop and stuff, but... I wouldn't say I'm worrying a lot. Just normal, I guess.
Do you often feel tense or on edge?
Not really. Uh... I don't think so, anyway. I'm just... you know, doing my work. I wouldn't say I feel tense.
Do you think your trouble focusing is mainly because of the pressure from the new workshop mortgage and equipment costs?
I mean... I don't know. Maybe? It's just... a lot of money, I guess. But I wouldn't say it's the only reason. I just... I don't really know why I can't focus.
Do you often have trouble organizing your tasks or keeping them in order?
Uh... no, not really. I just... I get my jobs lined up and do them. I wouldn't say I have trouble keeping them in order.
Did your concentration problems begin after taking on the workshop mortgage?
Yeah, I guess so. It's... it's been going on for about seven months now. Right around the time we signed for the mortgage and bought all that equipment.
Since this started, have you been having unwanted memories of a frightening or upsetting event that pop into your mind?
Uh... no. I haven't... I don't really have anything like that happening. No.
Do thoughts about the workshop mortgage keep interrupting your attention while you're trying to work?
Uh... no. I don't think it's that. I mean, I'm not really thinking about the money while I'm out on a job. It's just... I just have a hard time staying focused.
Do you often feel restless or find it hard to stay still?

Yeah, I guess. I just... I don't really sit still much lately. I've been going pretty much nonstop. Job sites, bids, rewiring panels back at the shop... I just keep starting new home-automation ideas before I finish the last one. Sitting around just... it feels like wasting time, you know?
Lately, have you been needing less sleep than usual?

I mean... yeah, I guess. For a few months now, I've only been sleeping... maybe three or four hours a night. 

But I'm not tired. I just wake up before dawn and... I don't know, I feel ready to go. Like I had a full night's rest. So I just get up and start pricing materials, answering emails... sketching out another system. Just... getting to work, really.
Lately, have you been feeling unusually upbeat or euphoric?

I don't know about euphoric. Just... pumped up, I guess. I've been talking a lot about making our shop the main solar outfit in town. It's a good plan. 

But... yeah, I suppose if my wife or one of the apprentices questions how we're going to do it, I... I can flip on them a bit. Get sharp over nothing. I just don't want to be slowed down.
Because of this high-energy period, have you needed to be hospitalized?
No. No, nothing like that. I haven't been in a hospital.
During this high-energy period, have you had any beliefs that other people said were unrealistic or not true?

I don't know about unrealistic... I mean, maybe. I've been telling people I'm ready to take on big commercial jobs. Expand the shop, train up a whole new crew to handle it. 

I guess... if I really stop and think about it, my licensing isn't quite there yet. And I probably don't have the experience for a jump like that right this second. But... it just feels like I could do it anyway.
Because of this high-energy period, have you had serious problems at work or at home because of it?

Yeah, I guess you could say that. Um... some of the clients have been complaining. Saying I missed details, or that I messed up the scheduling. And... the guys working under me, they're second-guessing me more. 

And at home... it's tense. My wife and I, we've been arguing a lot. Mostly about the mortgage and the business. She thinks I'm... risking everything we've built.
Has this high-energy period lasted at least a week?
Yeah. Longer than a week. Um... I guess it's been building for about seven months now. Ever since we took on the mortgage for the workshop... and the equipment.
During this high-energy period, have you heard voices or seen things that other people could not?
No. Nothing like that.
During this high-energy period, were you ever unable to work or take care of things because of it?
No. I mean... I'm still working. I haven't missed a day or anything. I just keep going.
